package.name: replanning_news_demo
package.description: Replanning on news: a courier, then a scout, then a cleaning robot in a residence at night, where news from outside the plan arrives mid-drive as a public announcement into ePlanSys's epistemic state, interrupts the policy, and the mission plans again from the restricted model. Against a tautology announced at the same instant, the policy kept, and classical replanning.
